page.layout: One column of running text, with the page number at the head. No margin notes, no running head. The catchword "Actio-" stands alone at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: tiam dixissent. Ante Romanum ergà[?] ex-
communicatum a Synodo, & ipsis Roma-
nis Pontificibus sententiam proferunt ab-
solutionis: excommunicatum eiectumque
a Synodo plena nulla in re hæsitantes, in
osculum amplectuntur; & salutem suam,
& Dei placitum in depositi excommunica-
tique communione ponunt. Et atrociora
investigamus? Et ridiculum plane est, pro-
fiteri fautores Photij, se ipsos uti viciniores,
& rebus præsentes, melius res tenuisse. Ro-
mani nanque Pontifices Nicolaus, & Adria-
nus non inconsulto, ac temere, sed re antea
diligentius pervestigata, testium, qui rebus
interfuerunt, accurato examine, tum præ-
missis ad Photium monitionibus, ut iniuste
occupata restitueret, & eo obnitente, &
restitutionem differente sententiam dixe-
runt. Et licet de Synodis Romanis in Pho-
tium idquoq; concederetur, quid ipsi dice-
rent de Synodo Generali Constantinopoli
adversus ipsum Photium coacta? Eam
etiam incompertas habuisse iuxta cum Ro-
manis fraudes, & conatus Photij? Vides
quam leviter Photiani isti in rebus serijs nu-
gantur? Planum itaque est ante Epistolam
Ioannis eosdem unitos fuisse Photio: nanque
post lectam Ioannis Papæ ad Imperatores
Epistolam idem Procopius subnectit eadem Actio-

page.notes: The first word "tiam" is a fragment of a word begun on the previous page. "ergà" is uncertain (accent-like mark over the a); marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "præ-missis" is a line-end hyphen. Orthography kept as printed (idquoq;, Photij, Ioannis, Epistolam); u/v and i/j normalised per the rules. No printing errors were corrected.
